Diagonal map alpha=diag(a,b) preserves e1⊢e1=e1 and e1⊢e2=e2 exactly when a(a−1)=0 and b(a−1)=0; the remaining slots give no extra polynomial condition. Taking twisted products gives {e1,e1}=0, {e1,e2}=be2−be2=0, and [e1,e2]=be2.
